nodes.label: docs/canon/raw/git_record.md — forensic reconstruction from git alone. Repo c:\Coding\exjobbet\GRAG-Job (remote Objuret/GRAG-Job), 30 refs, 77 commit objects (74 real commits + 3 refs/stash), range 2026-05-07 → 2026-08-01. Every claim verified against the actual git object with the reproduce command given inline; nothing taken from memory, from docs/state/, or from MEMORY.md

Authors per `git shortlog -sne --all`, all four identities the same person: Objuret <jochen@wikman.com> 43 commits, Joakim Wikman <jochen@wikman.com> 25, Joakim Sandström <h19josan@du.se> 8, Joakim <h19josan@du.se> 1. Labels used throughout: [USER] — first-person design voice, argument and counter-argument, decisions with dated sign-off markers, research reading with citations, profanity, and commit messages in the terse human register ("ok", "ragas", "småfix", "doit"); [AGENT] — an AI footer (Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7, Co-authored-by: Cursor), the mechanical `feat: update <dir> (N files)` tooling format, or Claude-memory frontmatter blocks; [UNKNOWN] — genuinely undecidable from git, which covers most May/June docs at the sentence level

The record's four parts: Part 1 an annotated commit timeline; Part 2 the design record, chronological; Part 3 contradictions and silent drops — 18 numbered contradictions C-1…C-18, the part that rests on hard evidence; Part 4 what git cannot tell you, the G-numbered limits. A caution applies to the whole record: this repo's design is carried in prose documents and prose authorship cannot be settled from git metadata. What git can settle is what existed when, what changed, what was deleted, and whether a later state contradicts an earlier one

Part 4 — what git cannot tell you. G-1 prose authorship is not decidable: git records who committed, never who wrote; all four author identities are one person, and footers appear on just eight commits, so every major design document carries no footer and is [UNKNOWN] as text however clearly the decisions in them are the user's. G-2 the decision events are outside the repo: DESIGN.md and MODEL_CONTRACTS.md are dense with dated decisions — decided 2026-06-11, 06-12, 06-13, REOPENED 06-14, finalized 06-12 — and there is no commit on any of those dates, the sequence jumping 18d11df (06-01) → 0efff16 (06-15), so every decision in that fortnight happened in conversation and arrived pre-formed in one 750-line commit. G-3 the state-transfer documents were never committed, and the 06-09, 06-11, 06-12 and 06-14 state docs are named-but-absent. G-4 why the built tagger dropped facets — the single most important unanswered question, with the spec, the reopening and the flat-list implementation all in git and nothing bridging them. G-5 whether anything was ever run on the v3 artefact

Standing: git_record.md is interpretation over state — an agent-written reconstruction, in the review pile like everything else, and its value is that its claims are re-runnable. It carries 91 reproduce commands; re-run them. It is not evidence under REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md, which admits git itself — commits, diffs and `git show <ref>:<path>` bytes — but not an agent's reading of git
